title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Answering the most common questions from our patients

items.q: How long does a session last?
items.a: Each session lasts about 45 minutes, depending on the service.

items.q: Do I need a doctor's referral?
items.a: No, you can book directly. In some cases, medical history may be requested.

items.q: How quickly will I see results?
items.a: Many patients feel improvement after the first session. Full recovery depends on your condition.

items.q: How do I cancel or reschedule an appointment?
items.a: You can contact us by phone or email at least 24 hours in advance.
